home.lead: Tell us what's missing, or back what others have already suggested. We read every request and reply to it.

feed.emptyLead: This board has just opened. The first request sets the tone for the rest — tell us what's worth improving.
feed.noMatchLead: Try dropping some conditions — the request you need may sit in another status or category.
feed.loadError: Could not load more of the feed.
feed.closedBoardLead: The “{board}” board is open to companies on a paid plan. If you have access, sign in with your work email.

post.commentPlaceholder: Add details that will help us work it out
post.mergedLead: We merged this request into another one — several people asked for the same thing. Votes and comments moved with it, and the work is tracked there.
post.emptyThread: No discussion yet. The first comment often decides whether the team gets to the bottom of it.

intake.autoTranslate: Your post will be translated into the other portal languages automatically
intake.envEmpty: Nothing was collected — fill it in by hand
intake.envNote: This is everything we send along with the request. Correct it if something is off.
intake.filesFull: No more than {count} files per request
intake.dropHint: Drop a screenshot, video or log — or
intake.bannedLead: A blocked account cannot create requests. Reading the portal still works.
intake.needSignInLead: A request is signed with your name — the team has to know who to come back to with a question.
intake.sentModerated: It appears in the feed after a review — usually within a few hours. We will write to you when the team replies or changes the status.
intake.sentPlain: We will write to you when the team replies or changes the status.
intake.limitLead: The limit keeps accidental duplicates out of the feed. You can continue in {wait}. If it has to be said right now — add the details as a comment on an existing request.
intake.chooserLead: The type decides the questions in the form: a bug needs steps to reproduce, an idea needs the problem it solves.
intake.bannedRead: Reading the portal works. Creating requests, voting and commenting does not.
intake.bannedNote: A block is lifted by hand. We will look into it within one working day.
intake.signInLeadScreen: Sign-in works through a link in an email, no password needed. Reading the portal and searching for similar requests works without it.
intake.similarFound: Looks like this came up before — {count} {label}
intake.similarHint: a vote on an existing one weighs more than a new request

profile.signedOutLead: Your requests, votes and email settings live here. Reading the portal works without signing in.
profile.title: Profile
profile.emptyVotes: You have not voted for anything yet. A vote is the fastest way to shape the queue.
profile.emptyPosts: You have not created any requests yet.
profile.lettersNote: Email arrives only for requests you follow. You can unsubscribe from a single request with the link inside the email — no sign-in needed.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.lead: We will email you a link — it works for 15 minutes and signs you in with one click.
auth.note: Voting and commenting need a sign-in. Reading the portal does not.
auth.errorInvalidEmail: Check the address — it looks like a typo.
auth.errorRateLimited: We have already sent several links to this address. Check your mail, including Spam — a new one can be requested in an hour.
auth.sentLead: The email went to {address}. Open the link inside — it brings you back to the page you started from.
auth.sentNote: The link works for 15 minutes. If the email is missing, check the Spam folder — it sometimes lands there on the first sign-in.
auth.failedInvalidText: It may have been copied partially: mail clients wrap long links onto a second line, and half of it stays behind.
auth.failedExpiredText: A link works for 15 minutes — enough to walk to your inbox, and not enough for whoever finds the email later.
auth.failedUsedText: Each link signs you in exactly once. If it was not you — request a new one and write to us.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.failedLead: Unsubscribing through this link did not work. All email can be set up in your profile — it also shows which requests you follow.
unsubscribe.failedNote: The link may have been copied partially, or the subscription is already gone.
unsubscribe.doneNote: Unsubscribing worked without a sign-in — straight from the link in the email.
unsubscribe.donePost: We will not write about updates to “{title}” any more.
unsubscribe.doneGeneric: We will not write about updates to this request any more.
unsubscribe.doneRest: The rest of the email keeps coming as before.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: What is planned, what is in progress and what has shipped.
roadmap.lead: Plans can change. A date appears once the work has started.
roadmap.empty: Empty so far. Requests show up here once the team picks them up.

changelog.title: What is new
changelog.description: A feed of releases and the requests they grew from.
changelog.lead: The links lead to the requests these changes grew from.
changelog.emptyType: No releases of this kind yet.
changelog.mailNote: Everyone who voted for these requests got an email about the release.
